scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Can a gifted elephant become a breach of trust case? And can cheating and breach of trust be alleged together, on the same facts?
On fifteenth October, twenty twenty six, the Kerala High Court, through a single bench of Honourable Justice A Badharudeen, answered both questions.
scenes.shown: On 15 October 2026, the Kerala High Court, through a single bench of Honourable Justice A. Badharudeen, answered both questions.

scenes.dialogue: The petitioner's case: an elephant gifted to a Mutt kept coming into musth, so in twenty seventeen it was gifted back. The donor then gifted it to him.
scenes.shown: The petitioner's case: an elephant gifted to a Math kept coming into musth, so in 2017 it was gifted back. The donor then gifted it to him.

scenes.dialogue: The complainant alleged it was only entrusted to him during musth, and not returned when asked. An F I R was registered for breach of trust and cheating.
scenes.shown: The complainant alleged it was only entrusted to him during musth, and not returned when asked. An FIR was registered for breach of trust and cheating.

scenes.dialogue: The complainant objected that an earlier petition to quash it was withdrawn without liberty. The Court said mere technicalities would not stand in the way of relief.
The Court held that cheating and criminal breach of trust are fundamentally contradictory, and cannot co-exist on the exact same set of allegations.
The complainant's counsel then pressed only breach of trust. But Section Four Oh Six needs entrustment by a person having dominion over the property.
scenes.shown: The complainant's counsel then pressed only breach of trust. But Section 406 needs entrustment by a person having dominion over the property.

scenes.dialogue: One who has parted with title and possession ceases to have dominion. The complainant disputes the gift deeds, but that is for a civil court to decide.
Finding not even primary material for either offence, the Court allowed the petition. The F I R and all further proceedings stand quashed.
scenes.shown: Finding not even primary material for either offence, the Court allowed the petition. The FIR and all further proceedings stand quashed.
